target_0.title: Botan
target_0.desc:
A fairy spirit in the form of a lion, serving as a guardian of abundance and Lanna art. It was born from a peony flower, a symbol of wealth, honor, and prosperity.

Its appearance is inspired by the Singha guardian figure, combined with Lanna botanical motifs, intricate vine patterns, and golden accents. These elements represent the power of nature, sacredness, elegance, and the preservation of Lanna cultural heritage through a contemporary character design.

“Bo-Tan” embodies the beliefs surrounding abundance, prosperity, good fortune, and protection, blending the symbolism of the peony, the guardian Singha, and the sacred power of nature according to Lanna traditions.

target_1.title: Lion
target_1.desc: A powerful magical lion with a radiant mane inspired by the sun. It stands for courage, leadership, and protection.

target_2.title: Heart
target_2.desc: A magical heart symbol that represents love, kindness, and human connection. Its glowing energy spreads warmth and hope.

target_3.title: Deer
target_3.desc: A graceful mystical deer symbolizing peace, harmony, and a deep connection with nature. It moves silently through enchanted forests.

target_4.title: Leaf
target_4.desc: A magical leaf infused with the spirit of nature. It represents growth, renewal, and the balance of life.
